_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run. Two real score movements, no new opportunities founded. ai-skills-wage-premium-it-developers moved 3->5 after adding two new independent institutions: a January 2026 causal hiring experiment (arXiv/SSRN preprint, Stephany/Teutloff/Leone, 1,725 recruiters, conjoint design, listing AI skills raises software-engineer interview odds 8-15pp) and PwC's 2026 Global AI Jobs Barometer's wage-premium cut (62% average AI-skills premium in 2026, up from 25% in 2024) -- evidenceStrength 4->5, corroborationBreadth 2->4 (3 institutions, 3 tiers), maturity Emerging->Growing Adoption. ai-workforce-impact-slowly-rising-tide moved 3->4 after adding an independent NBER survey of ~750 corporate executives (w34984, found via working-paper browsing rather than keyword search) corroborating the MIT task-capability 'gradual curve' thesis from the realized-employment side (<0.4% aggregate 2026 employment decline from AI). data-foundation-investment-differentiates-ai-success stayed at 4 but gained a third independent institution (IDC Office of the CDO Survey 2025, 417 data leaders) closing this run's Data Engineering search with a genuine finding. Product Management (still the thinnest role at 1) had three leads investigated and closed as ineligible/unverifiable rather than admitted: the Gartner QA one-minute-insights piece is now confirmed dated to 2023 data (too old); the McKinsey 40-PM study was dated to July 2024 (too old); a 'BCG 34% senior PM hiring growth' stat circulating on aggregator/marketing sites could not be verified against BCG's own pages and was rejected as likely misattribution. Red-teamed all thirteen evidenceScore>=4 opportunities (eleven carried over plus the two newly-qualifying ones); no new threshold-clearing contradictions found for any. NBER's dead-source streak (10 consecutive empty runs) was resolved by browsing recent working papers directly instead of keyword search -- recommend keeping this method for NBER going forward. BLS remains above threshold and climbed to 9. McKinsey, Accenture, and Forrester newly crossed the >=6 dead-source threshold this run (6 each) -- flagged for varied query framing next run, though none read as genuinely dead (each surfaced real material that was either already captured or too weak to admit).
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
